SESSION	create temporary view hav as select * from values
READ	SELECT udf(k) AS k, udf(sum(v)) FROM hav GROUP BY k HAVING udf(sum(v)) > 2
READ	SELECT udf(count(udf(k))) FROM hav GROUP BY v + 1 HAVING v + 1 = udf(2)
READ	SELECT udf(MIN(t.v)) FROM (SELECT * FROM hav WHERE v > 0) t HAVING(udf(COUNT(udf(1))) > 0)
READ	SELECT udf(a + b) FROM VALUES (1L, 2), (3L, 4) AS T(a, b) GROUP BY a + b HAVING a + b > udf(1)
